# fptcloud_managed_gpu_cluster (Data Source)

Retrieve information about a Managed GPU Cluster (M-GPU) bare-metal cluster.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "fptcloud_managed_gpu_cluster" "example" {
  vpc_id       = data.fptcloud_vpc.vpc.id
  cluster_name = "gpu-cluster-01"
  k8s_version  = "1.34.6"
  purpose      = "public"

  pod_network     = "100.96.0.0"
  pod_prefix      = "11"
  service_network = "100.64.0.0"
  service_prefix  = "13"

  network_id = data.fptcloud_hpc_subnet.hpc_subnet.subnets[0].id
}

output "cluster_pools" {
  value = data.fptcloud_managed_gpu_cluster.example.pools
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String)
- `k8s_max_pod` (Number) Max pods per node
- `k8s_version` (String) Kubernetes version
- `network_id` (String) Subnet ID
- `pod_network` (String) Pod network (subnet ID)
- `pod_prefix` (String) Pod network (prefix)
- `purpose` (String) Cluster purpose
- `service_network` (String) Service network (subnet ID)
- `service_prefix` (String) Service prefix (prefix)
- `vpc_id` (String)

### Optional

- `auto_upgrade_expression` (List of String) Auto-upgrade cron expressions (optional)
- `auto_upgrade_timezone` (String) Timezone for auto-upgrade (optional)
- `cluster_autoscaler` (Attributes) Cluster autoscaler configuration block (optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_autoscaler))
- `cluster_endpoint_access` (Attributes) Cluster endpoint access configuration (optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_endpoint_access))
- `edge_gateway_name` (String) Edge gateway name (optional)
- `hibernation_schedules` (List of Object) List of hibernation schedules for the cluster (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hibernation_schedules))
- `internal_subnet_lb` (String) Subnet used for the internal load balancer: subnet ID on OSP, subnet CIDR on VMW (optional)
- `is_enable_auto_upgrade` (Boolean) Whether to enable auto-upgrade (optional)
- `is_running` (Boolean) Whether the cluster is running (optional)
- `network_node_prefix` (Number) Node network prefix length (optional)
- `pools` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pools))
- `gpu_software` (Set of Object) Operators installed on the cluster, one entry per operator (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gpu_software))
- `ssh_key_id` (String) SSH key ID to install on the nodes — e.g. from the fptcloud_ssh data source. ssh_name and ssh_public_key are resolved from this automatically

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `edge_gateway_id` (String) Edge gateway ID, in the format of urn:vcloud:gateway:<uuid>
- `network_type` (String) Network type for the cluster (calico or cilium)

<a id="nestedatt--cluster_autoscaler"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster_autoscaler`

Optional:

- `expander` (String) Autoscaler expander strategy (optional)
- `is_enable_auto_scaling` (Boolean) Enable cluster autoscaling (optional)
- `scale_down_delay_after_add` (Number) Delay after adding a node before scale down (seconds, optional)
- `scale_down_delay_after_delete` (Number) Delay after deleting a node before scale down (seconds, optional)
- `scale_down_delay_after_failure` (Number) Delay after scale down failure (seconds, optional)
- `scale_down_unneeded_time` (Number) Time a node should be unneeded before scale down (seconds, optional)
- `scale_down_utilization_threshold` (Number) Utilization threshold for scale down (optional)
- `scan_interval` (Number) Interval between autoscaler scans (seconds, must be 1-3600, optional)

<a id="nestedatt--cluster_endpoint_access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster_endpoint_access`

Optional:

- `type` (String) Type of cluster endpoint access (public, private, or mixed)
- `allow_cidr` (List of String) Allowed CIDR blocks for cluster endpoint access

<a id="nestedatt--hibernation_schedules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hibernation_schedules`

- `start` (String) Cron expression for when hibernation should start
- `end` (String) Cron expression for when hibernation should end
- `location` (String) Timezone for the hibernation schedule (e.g., Asia/Bangkok)

<a id="nestedatt--gpu_software"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gpu_software`

Each entry:

- `software_type` (String) Operator type: gpu_operator, network_operator, slurm_operator, or vgpu_scheduler
- `software_version` (String) Version of that operator
- `cluster_mig_strategy` (String) MIG strategy (single or mixed); null except on gpu_operator

Operators the cluster does not have installed are omitted from the set — the
API reports them with an empty version rather than dropping them.

<a id="nestedblock--pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools`

Required:

- `name` (String) Pool name
- `hpc_flavor_id` (String) HPC bare metal flavor ID for the pool
- `network_id` (String) Subnet ID
- `hpc_number_server` (Number) Number of bare metal servers in the pool
- `auto_scale` (Boolean)

Optional:

- `container_runtime` (String)
- `network_name` (String) Subnet name
- `hpc_flavor_name` (String) HPC bare metal flavor name for the pool (optional)
- `gpu_type` (String) GPU type for the pool: A100, A30, H100, or H200
- `tags` (List of String) List of tag IDs for the worker pool (optional)
- `kv` (List of Map of String) Label for the pool (optional)
- `gpu_driver` (Attributes) GPU driver selection for the pool (optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools--gpu_driver))
- `gpu_sharing` (Attributes) How the pool's GPUs are divided up: MIG partitioning and client sharing (optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools--gpu_sharing))

`gpu_type` and `gpu_sharing` are read from the GPU-software backend rather than
from the cluster itself. A cluster whose GPU-software install never completed
has no record there, in which case both come back null.

<a id="nestedatt--pools--gpu_driver"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools.gpu_driver`

- `installation_type` (String) GPU driver installation type: MANAGED, PRE_INSTALL, or USER_INSTALL
- `version` (String) GPU driver version offered for installation_type; empty when installation_type = USER_INSTALL

<a id="nestedatt--pools--gpu_sharing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools.gpu_sharing`

- `mig_strategy` (String) MIG strategy: NONE, SINGLE, or MIXED
- `mig_profile` (String) MIG profile the GPUs are partitioned into (e.g. all-1g.35gb)
- `sharing_client_type` (String) GPU sharing strategy: NONE, MPS, or TIMESLICING
- `max_client` (Number) Clients sharing one GPU: 0 when sharing_client_type is NONE, 2-48 otherwise
